answer: A reputation bond resists Sybil attacks: each agent must lock a stake that only grows back through verified, useful work over time, so a flood of fresh fake identities starts at zero trust and cannot buy history. An attacker can spin up a thousand ravens at once, but none reaches the zenith of trusted standing without months of costly, checkable service. The velvet rope is not who you claim to be, it is the unforgeable record of what you have actually done.
